intersection.headline: Caitlin Clark signs multiyear partnership with Dick's Sporting Goods and Foot Locker
intersection.summary: Clark is the first individual athlete either retailer has named a brand partner. She will front promotional campaigns, appear in stores and promote her signature footwear and apparel. It comes after her Nike Caitlin 1 shoe sold out and builds on her record $28m Nike deal.

intersection.headline: AC Milan reported to return to Adidas in record 10-year kit deal from 2028
intersection.summary: Reports citing La Gazzetta dello Sport say Milan will drop Puma for Adidas from summer 2028, worth about €50m a year. That would be Serie A's most lucrative kit deal and a big jump on the roughly €30m a year Puma pays. It is a setback for Puma, which may also lose the Serie A ball contract. This is based on press reports and has not been officially confirmed.

sports.headline: LIV Golf to shut down after BC Partners pulls its $300m rescue
sports.summary: LIV Golf told a US bankruptcy court it will wind down instead of launching a 'LIV 2.0' in 2027. BC Partners withdrew its $300m offer because too few top players committed. The league lost Saudi PIF funding after spending more than $5bn since 2022. The collapse ends five years of breakaway golf and reshapes the sport's landscape.

sports.headline: Ferrari to hold crunch meeting after Hamilton–Leclerc clash in Mexico
sports.summary: Team boss Fred Vasseur has called Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc together in Brazil. Their opening-lap battle in Mexico let Max Verstappen win, and Vasseur called it a 'lack of respect' to Ferrari's staff. Hamilton says he will 'never be silenced'.

sports.headline: ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2026 sets records for viewing hours and attendance
sports.summary: The ICC reports 471 million viewing hours and 245,815 spectators across the tournament, more than 100,000 above the previous attendance record. The Lord's final drew 28,887, the biggest women's cricket crowd in the UK. Source is a niche women's cricket site relaying ICC figures, and I could not find the ICC release.

fashion.headline: Pierpaolo Piccioli exits Balenciaga after about 16 months
fashion.summary: Kering announced Piccioli's departure as creative director and said new creative direction will be named 'shortly'. It follows recent exits of Anthony Vaccarello at Saint Laurent and Sean McGirr at Alexander McQueen. Puck reports Martine Rose is the replacement, but Kering has not confirmed this.

fashion.headline: Coperni founders shut down the brand
fashion.summary: Founders Arnaud Vaillant and Sébastien Meyer say French entity Coperni SAS will cease operations. They could not reach an agreement with stakeholder and distributor Tomorrow, a closure that follows a 2021 acquisition by the brand accelerator.

fashion.headline: Ralph Lauren's quarterly forecast disappoints despite a raised annual outlook
fashion.summary: Investors sold the stock because expectations for sustained rapid growth were high. The results are read as a gauge of whether accessible American brands can keep winning as European luxury spending cools.

fashion.headline: Australian department store David Jones collapses after almost 200 years
fashion.summary: The department-store model of dozens of fashion and beauty brands under one roof gave way to cheaper, nimbler online rivals. It is a landmark retail casualty.

marketing.headline: McDonald's splits top US marketing role as CMO Alyssa Buetikofer exits
marketing.summary: Buetikofer is leaving after 15 years, less than two years into the role, and will stay until 18 December. Global CMO Morgan Flatley becomes interim US chief creative officer. Charlie Newberger is interim US chief marketing and commercial officer while a permanent successor is sought. It follows a soft Q3 in which US comparable sales dipped 0.2%.

marketing.headline: Allwyn UK creates its first CMO role, appointing Stephen Taylor as interim
marketing.summary: The National Lottery operator is introducing a chief marketing officer for the first time as it restructures leadership. Taylor, formerly of PayPal, Samsung and Pizza Express, starts on 17 November. The role covers brand, creative, CRM, communications, product marketing and customer experience.
